title: Debug Lifecycle Inspector: unified failed-request timeline & payload lens
creator: Alex Rivera
description:
Goal: Design a compact, scannable Debug Lifecycle Inspector that surfaces failed request timelines, automatic retry traces, error taxonomy, and an inline payload lens so engineers can triage regressions without context switching. Scope covers canvas-level UX for: 1) failed-request timeline (multi-request grouping by root cause), 2) retry ancestry & outcome lanes, 3) canonical error taxonomy badges + expandable classifier, 4) payload lens with KV diff, truncated streaming request/response view, and quick-actions (re-run, copy-payload, open in sandbox).

Design constraints and assumptions:
- Must fit as a right-rail inspector within the existing request detail surface (200–420px width).
- Support streaming payloads: show prefix tokens and allow 'jump to timestamp' for large responses.
- Retry chains can be multi-tiered; we collapse identical retries and show an 'expand all' affordance.
- Error taxonomy derived from Research: network | model-internal | quota | client-error | infra-timeout. Badge color palette aligned with console semantic colors.

Decisions and trade-offs:
- Chose vertical timeline with horizontal lanes (requests, retries, infra events) to communicate sequential causality and concurrency; alternative was a compact table but lost causality context.
- Avoided full JSON tree expansion inline to keep inspector lightweight; implemented a quick 'payload diff' modal for deep inspection.
- Prefers progressive disclosure: topmost row shows summary + one-line classifier; users can expand to see full payload and debug links.

Prototype links: see Figma files in design_files. Interactive prototype demonstrates: hover-to-highlight across timeline, copy-payload shortcut, and a lightweight rerun flow that keeps original headers.

Acceptance criteria (UX + engineering handoff):
- Visual QA: badges, lane alignment, and keyboard focus states match figma spec.
- Interaction QA: timeline scrub jumps to corresponding streaming token in payload lens.
- Performance: inspector load time <150ms when fetching cached payloads, fallback async load when not cached.
- Edge cases: very large payloads display truncated view with 'open in sandbox' action.

Next steps / open questions for Eng: 
- What is the max payload size returning from runtime endpoints we should assume before we require server-side truncation? (ENG input needed)
- Can we fetch and render KV cache diffs from the serving runtime APIs or should Console compute diffs client-side?

Links to referenced artifacts and infra tickets included in attachments.
ux_notes: Accessibility: ensure timeline nodes are reachable via keyboard and have accessible names; color-only badges must include text/icon. Mobile: inspector is hidden on small widths but available in compact modal. Onboarding: add ephemeral tooltip explaining taxonomy on first use.
